characters.name: Azure
characters.description: Bright sky-blue #37A4F4, a soft BARREL cushion: softly cylindrical body, broad curved sides, gently domed top and bottom, just slightly taller than wide. Distinct from the original square Blue Atlas. Tiny matching blue arms and feet. Large readable black oval eyes.
characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production animation sprite sheet for one original Hermes Studio cushion companion.
Input image 1 is a MATERIAL AND CHARACTER-FAMILY REFERENCE ONLY: match its dense short upholstered microfiber surface, softly stuffed construction, tiny mitten-like arms and stubby feet, and familiar two glossy black oval eyes. Create ONE NEW distinct character defined below, not a recoloring of one of the reference's four bodies.
OUTPUT: one square PNG on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. Exactly FOUR separate full-body renders of THE SAME ONE CHARACTER, in a clean evenly spaced 2×2 animation grid. All four renders have identical body design, color, face position and scale. Each character is centered within its quadrant, with generous transparent margins and a wide empty transparent horizontal/vertical gutter. Keep the entire body, both arms and both feet inside its own quadrant. No overlap between quadrants. Orthographic frontal camera and consistent feet baseline and object height within each cell. Simple diffuse premium 3D studio light from upper left, subtle shading on the character itself, no floor or cast shadow.
FRAME POSITIONS, ABSOLUTELY REQUIRED:
TOP LEFT: idle, facing forward, BOTH eyes fully OPEN glossy black vertical ovals, arms gently down at sides, relaxed neutral friendly presence.
TOP RIGHT: BLINK of that exact top-left pose. Identical body pose, shape, feet and arm positions and location. BOTH eyes fully CLOSED, represented by two short soft charcoal curved eyelid lines. No open eye ovals in this quadrant.
BOTTOM LEFT: curious, slight 6–8 degree head/body lean while still facing front, both eyes fully open, tiny arms resting. Same size and feet baseline.
BOTTOM RIGHT: gentle friendly ONE-ARM WAVE, the character's right arm (viewer left) lifted slightly outward and up; other arm remains resting, both eyes open. Same body and face proportions, same size and feet baseline.
IMPORTANT: four poses of the SAME colored character, never four different colored characters. Body is a SINGLE soft upholstered cushion with no separate human head or torso. Only two black oval eyes, NO mouth, nose, eyebrows, ears, hair, horns, animal anatomy, plant parts, fingers, props, clothing or shoes. Friendly, tactile, simple, premium. Microfiber is dense short upholstery, not shaggy fur, knitted yarn, felt seams or plastic. No text, labels, numbers, arrows, watermark, border, floor, stage, pedestal, backdrop, checkerboard painted into image, ground shadows, or color swatches. Every background pixel outside the character cutouts must have alpha=0.
CHARACTER DESIGN FOR EVERY ONE OF THE FOUR QUADRANTS: Bright sky-blue #37A4F4, a soft BARREL cushion: softly cylindrical body, broad curved sides, gently domed top and bottom, just slightly taller than wide. Distinct from the original square Blue Atlas. Tiny matching blue arms and feet. Large readable black oval eyes.
